name: live-v16-save-readback
objective: v2.3 replan V16, live (no model): a save the server never receives is evidence of a lost write; the save that follows is CONFIRMED against the server's own stored chat file (a real `/api/chats/group/get` round trip, counted here), not against the page's in-memory metadata that the extension itself just wrote; and a healthy save after that is trusted without a round trip.

steps.eval: const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.__v16Reads = 0; globalThis.__v16Original = original; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input?.url ?? String(input); if (url.includes('/api/chats/group/get') || url.includes('/api/chats/get')) globalThis.__v16Reads += 1; return original(input, init); }; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.persist(); return { outcome: rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth.lastOutcome };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.persist(); const health = rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth; if (health.lastOutcome !== 'unsaved') throw new Error(`a save that never reached the server was not evidence of a lost write: ${JSON.stringify(health)}`); return { outcome: health.lastOutcome, reason: health.lastReason };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = globalThis.__v16Reads; await rt.persist(); const health = rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth; const reads = globalThis.__v16Reads - before; if (health.lastOutcome !== 'applied') throw new Error(`recovery not confirmed: ${JSON.stringify(health)}`); if (reads < 1) throw new Error('the recovery was confirmed without reading the server copy of the chat'); return { outcome: health.lastOutcome, serverReads: reads };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = globalThis.__v16Reads; await rt.persist(); const reads = globalThis.__v16Reads - before; const health = rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth; globalThis.fetch = globalThis.__v16Original; if (health.lastOutcome !== 'applied') throw new Error(`a healthy save was not applied: ${JSON.stringify(health)}`); if (reads !== 0) throw new Error(`a healthy save after a healthy save paid a round trip (${reads})`); return { outcome: health.lastOutcome, serverReads: reads };
